meta.name: capa-officer
meta.description: CAPA system management for medical device QMS. Covers root cause analysis, corrective action planning, effectiveness verification, and CAPA metrics. Use when running CAPA investigations, 5-Why analysis, fishbone diagrams, root cause determination, corrective action tracking, effectiveness verification, or CAPA program optimization.

copy.tagline: 管理医疗器械质量体系的CAPA流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责医疗器械质量体系中的CAPA调查与改进。
copy.tagline_en: Manage CAPA processes for medical device QMS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle CAPA investigations and improvements in medical device quality management.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理医疗器械质量体系的 CAPA（纠正与预防措施）流程，包括根本原因分析、制定纠正计划、验证效果和生成指标报告。
howto.when: 当你需要处理 CAPA 调查、进行 5-Why 分析、鱼骨图分析、确定根本原因、跟踪纠正措施、验证有效性或优化 CAPA 程序时触发。

say.text: 帮我用5-Why分析pH计校准超期的根本原因。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成5-Why分析并记录证据。

say.text: 生成一份CAPA状态报告，包含超期率和周期时间。
say.note: Claude 会计算并展示关键指标。

say.text: 为这个客户投诉制定纠正措施计划。
say.note: Claude 会指导你填写行动计划模板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage the CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) process for medical device QMS, including root cause analysis, corrective action planning, effectiveness verification, and generating metrics reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to run CAPA investigations, perform 5-Why analysis, fishbone diagrams, root cause determination, corrective action tracking, effectiveness verification, or CAPA program optimization.

say_en.text: Help me perform a 5-Why analysis for the pH meter calibration overdue issue.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the 5-Why analysis and record evidence.

say_en.text: Generate a CAPA status report including overdue rate and cycle time.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate and display key metrics.

say_en.text: Create a corrective action plan for this customer complaint.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through filling the action plan template.
